purpose: Controlled validation of the explicit-anchor + ordered-pixel-path digitization engine only. Not automatic recognition; not experimental source data.

source_image.coordinate_system: local panel image pixels; origin (0,0) at top-left; x increases right, y increases down

panel.semantic_panel: Figure 5a - CV curves of PVO//modified Cu and PVO//normal Cu full cells
panel.basis: Plot frame measured from the image dark-pixel runs; corresponds to the visible rectangular CV frame of panel a.

x_axis.label: Voltage (V)
x_axis.basis: Seven visible bottom ticks evenly spaced 56-57 px apart; grid linearity confirmed against intermediates.

y_axis.label: Current (A g-1)
y_axis.basis: Six visible left ticks spaced about 42 px; intermediates used only as consistency check, not as extra anchors.

curve.identity: PVO // modified Cu, 4th cycle, anodic (positive-current) branch, solid red line
curve.ordering: Visual sweep order from low voltage (left) to high voltage (right); points were NOT sorted by x.
curve.segment_scope: Continuous anodic segment from about 0.30 V to 1.64 V; excludes the vertical end-of-sweep drop and the cathodic return branch.
curve.ambiguity_note: The dashed red 1st-cycle trace and grey normal-Cu trace run close to the solid red line in places; points were selected on the solid red stroke only. Around x=195-255 and x=307-330 the solid red stroke is visibly distinct.

limitations: Manual annotation by visual inspection of an existing raster crop; no external PDF/SI was consulted.
A successful map proves only the controlled engine path (explicit anchors + ordered pixel points), not automatic curve detection.
Not a scientific data product; requires user-approved annotation and review before any research use.
